svg.aria-label: Drawing CLR-PT-102: CLEAR POINT LARGE · COUNTER
svg.text: 1. BARE 7.5 IN PANEL ASSUMED 170.2 × 111.2 × 1.2, ACTIVE 163.2 × 97.9. CONFIRM WITH THE DATASHEET.
2. SAME BOARD, FIRMWARE AND STACK AS CLR-PT-101. COUNTER USE: USB-C POWERED, CELL NOT FITTED.
3. FOOT: SAME DESIGN AS CLR-PT-201, SCALED; STEEL PLATE 160 × 32 × 3 ALWAYS FITTED.
4. FRAME WIDER THAN 150 MM: PRINT FACE DOWN, BRIM ON, AND CHECK FOR WARP BEFORE BONDING.
